name: MSADPT Unicode Identity Ambiguity Research Catalog
purpose: Track evidence requirements for defensive detection of Unicode identity ambiguity in Active Directory without performing exploitation.

references.title: Identity Crisis: Novel Vulnerabilities Leading to Kerberos Downgrade, DoS, and Full Domain Takeover

references.name: KerberLoss
references.category: Active Directory Domain Services elevation of privilege

detectionPrinciples: Inspect values returned from broad object collection on the client side; do not rely only on LDAP filters for a suspicious character.
Preserve raw strings, Unicode code points, normalized forms, object SID, object GUID, and distinguished name.
Treat suspicious Unicode and normalized collisions as leads, not proof of exploitation.
Patch state and delegated write permissions remain separate prerequisite evidence.
Do not create, rename, modify, or authenticate as a test object during detection.
